why: A tracked Markdown, YAML, JSON, or TOML file must not name an in-tree path that does not exist. After the multi-repo split, routing docs that still point at `.remote-dev/state/` or a deleted coordinator tree are drift, not history.
format_note: JSON, not YAML, so the guard stays stdlib-only and can run in every existing CI job without a pip install step.

scan.include_suffixes_why: These are the tracked routing and policy surfaces an agent actually reads. Python is already covered by repo_boundary_check.py.
scan.skip_roots_why: Volatile upstream submodules; not ours to police.
scan.fixture_paths_why: This guard's own tests must name dead paths as fixtures to prove detection. Nothing else belongs here: a file that genuinely needs an exemption needs a baseline row or a skip_paths entry with a why.

skip_paths.why: The retired ledger records historical source locations that left this tree. Those scaffold_path values stay as written as the extraction record.
Rule why-strings name the departed paths whose in-tree form the boundary guard forbids. Editing them would change a sibling-owned policy.
Historical CLI overlay fixture that intentionally names deleted .remote-dev tools as substrate targets.
This policy names scan roots and allow prefixes; those strings are not claims the prefixes exist as files.
The baseline must repeat the dead token it is accepting; scanning it would make every row a new violation.

Sibling-owned skill-script knowledge file. It names a retired helper under scripts/; this package cannot edit .agents/skills/*/scripts/.

scan.skip_paths_why: A handful of tracked policy/fixture files must name departed or external paths as data. They are listed here with a why, not hidden in the fixture exemption.

token_prefixes_why: These are the in-repo roots an agent is told to open. A token must start with one of them and contain at least one slash, so a prose mention of `docs` or `scripts` is not a path.

allow_prefixes.why: Untracked runtime state; legitimately absent from the tracked tree.

rules.title: Tracked docs must not name a missing in-tree path
rules.why: A reader who follows a `.agents/`, `docs/`, or `.remote-dev/` path that is not in this tree is being routed at the pre-migration layout.
